svg.text: PROPOSED: Calder Quay — a mini city for Blackout Protocol
Same rules, same objectives — blocks, streets, a square, a park and a canal instead of rooms and corridors
All floor reachable on foot: yes
Walk pad → cabinets: avg 73 m, max 135 m
Farthest spot from the pad: 156 m
Exposure: a spot sees ~38 floor tiles
